meta.name: Akkad Bakkad Rafu Chakkar
meta.description: The “good life” is just one scam away. This thought takes root in the minds of two friends Bhargav and Siddhant after they read countless news stories of bank scams that have happened in the country and that a total of seventy-one thousand five hundred crores has been scammed. Together they devise a plan to open India’s first fake bank. Will they get away or will they get caught?

videos.title: Akkad Bakkad
videos.overview: One night while drinking with his best friend Siddhant, Bhargav Sharma comes up with the plan of opening India's first fake bank and doing a never before scam. Bhargav is motivated by revenge while Siddhant wants the money to marry his girlfriend.

videos.title: Bakaiti Ya Dakaiti
videos.overview: Rhea joins her boyfriend Siddhant in the plan. Both of them then form a team, convincing Radha who runs a local money lending business and her girlfriend Khushi to join them. Things take a turn when Bhargav approaches his professor, Hari Shukla to join.

videos.title: Zameer Farosh
videos.overview: Bhargav informs the team about Hoshiargarh where they will convert his old house into a fake bank. Khushi joins Bhargav to secure a loan which they desperately need to begin.

videos.title: Nahane Ki Iccha
videos.overview: Khushi tells Bhargav all her secrets. The team leaves for Hoshiargarh. The local postman it seems has heard their plans.

videos.title: Sab Chidi Baaz
videos.overview: Siddhant and Bhargav return home to print passbooks and other papers to run the bank. Rhea convinces her father to let her go to Hoshiargarh.

videos.title: Saam Daam Dand Bhed
videos.overview: The team decides to get a celebrity to endorse the bank and convince people to open accounts. The local reporter has doubts on their operations.

videos.title: Goldfish
videos.overview: The team decides to get a local Godman into the game in order to get money from the sand mining mafia. Hari goes to convince the reporter to join them.

videos.title: Mausere Bhai
videos.overview: Khushi asks the bank manager to join their plan. Rhea's father recalls her home. A local gang of theives decides to rob the fake bank seeing the amount of money coming in.

videos.title: Nau Do Gyarah
videos.overview: Professor Hari tells them how he is planning to get the money out of the country. Radha and Khushi break up. Siddhant has a fight with Bhargav

videos.title: Nayi Shuruat
videos.overview: Bhargav comes to know a secret Hari is hiding. The local gang robs the bank with a unique idea. Bhargav and Siddhant are called to the police headquarters.
